B3-light.reason: SciFact nDCG@5, MRR, and Recall@5 are lower than B2-lexical; it also adds pattern plus fusion cost.

B3-original-lexical.reason: SciFact nDCG@5, MRR, and Recall@5 are lower than B2-lexical, which uses fewer stages.

B3-original-pattern.reason: Its small B0 gain adds no hard-set separation and is dominated by retained B2-lexical on SciFact.

B3-reference.reason: It regresses every primary SciFact metric relative to B1-reference and adds CPU signal cost; the hard set is saturated.

recommended_default.decision: retain B1-reference when CUDA latency is acceptable
recommended_default.reason: B1-reference has the strongest measured SciFact metrics. Use B2-lexical for a CPU-only low-cost deployment.
